name: zclass_list_render_active_cameras
description: zClass_List::RenderActiveCameras walks the camera type-list bucket, reports a missing camera list, skips inactive cameras, and dispatches active cameras to the software or scene renderer based on the active renderer path.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this list wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/render path pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f630 validates bucket 8 lookup, stderr fprintf on an empty camera list with return 1, node/next capture before dispatch, active flag bit 4 test, zero renderer-path dispatch to zClass_Camera::RenderScene, nonzero renderer-path dispatch to zVideo_sw::RenderFrame, loop over next links, and return 0 after the last link.

The native smoke verifies the empty-list error return, inactive-camera skip, active software-renderer dispatch through RenderScene on a bounded camera/world fixture, active view-context installation, auto-clip update, LOD reset, and variant override propagation.
